newsitem.title: SYRIA: Syria sells Jordan 50,000 tonnes of black barley.
newsitem.headline: Syria sells Jordan 50,000 tonnes of black barley.

text.p: Syria's General Establishment for Cereal Processing and Trade (GECPT) has sold Jordan 50,000 tonnes of barley at $138 per tonnes, a senior GECPT official said on Sunday.
He told Reuters the agreement was reached during talks in Damascus between GECPT officials and a Jordanian Ministry of Supply team. The barley would be delivered immediately.
The new contract would bring Jordan's imports of Syrian barley during the last seven months to more than 400,000 tonnes.
The barley would be exported to neighbouring Jordan by a joint Syrian-Jordanian transportation company by road from the GECPT's stores in Daraa on the border with Jordan, the official said.
